title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region residency + audit logging for Private deployments
author: Priya Menon
description:
Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private requested stricter enforcement for KMS key residency to meet data residency requirements. RBAC v1 allowed configuration-time mismatches and audit logs were insufficient to detect cross-region key usage. This PR introduces enforcement checks for KMS region residency at API-level, enriches audit logging for every KMS operation, and adds a migration/diagnostics path for existing configurations.

What changed: added server-side residency validation that rejects KMS keys not pinned to the same region as the deployment when the tenant policy requires residency; introduced detailed audit events for CreateKey/Encrypt/Decrypt/Wrap/Unwrap including key_id, region, requestor, policy_snapshot, and result; extended RBAC v2 policy schema to include kms_residency fields and enforcement modes (audit|enforce); added a migration tool to scan existing KMS bindings and optionally flag or auto-apply residency tags.

Files & areas touched: See files_changed for a high-level list. Key changes are in rbac policy handling, audit pipeline, private installer hooks, and integration tests.

Testing & verification: unit tests for policy parsing and enforcement, integration tests running a local fake-kms to simulate cross-region calls, end-to-end validation in a private-deploy smoke harness. CI initially flaked on one integration test; rerun passed.

Rollout plan: Feature gated behind config:rbac_v2.kms_residency.enabled and defaulted to "audit" to avoid immediate customer impact. We will enable enforcement for internal test tenants for 72 hours, monitor audit streams and SLOs, and then propose a staged enablement for customers with an opt-in window. Migration tool will be provided as a one-time job with dry-run mode.

Risk & mitigation: Risk of false rejects if customers use cross-region key replication. Mitigation: audit mode by default, clear error messages with guidance, and a migration tool to populate residency tags. Detailed rollback instructions included in the PR.

Related: Linear ENG-4987, SEC-213; linked support ticket SUP-1284.

release_notes:
- Enforce KMS region residency policy for Private deployments (rbac_v2.kms_residency)
- Add detailed audit events for KMS operations to improve compliance visibility
- Provide migration tool to detect non-resident KMS bindings (dry-run + apply)
- Default mode is 'audit' to avoid breaking consumer configs
notes: Feature gated: will remain in 'audit' mode by default. Operations: Run tools/migrations/run_kms_residency_scan.sh --dry-run to evaluate impact before enabling enforcement.
risk_acknowledgement: Customers using cross-region replication may need to update configs or run the migration tool. Product & support have been notified and a KB article is prepared.
